page.content:
King and protector of Wakanda.

How Black Panther connects

  • Location: Wakanda — Black Panther rules and protects Wakanda.
  • Faction: Avengers — Black Panther allies with the Avengers.

What is Black Panther?

Black Panther is the mantle of Wakanda's ruler—most famously T'Challa—who defends the nation and joins the Avengers on the world stage.

Key threads lead to Wakanda and Avengers.
